_about: Age x ethnicity/nationality figures for the age selector (schema harm-data/age-bands/v1). Built from official sources; values are never imputed or pro-rated. Category labels are kept as published.

fit_codes.exact: published band(s) add up exactly to the standard band
fit_codes.derived_exact: obtained exactly by adding/subtracting published cells (no assumptions)
fit_codes.computed_microdata: our tabulation of an official record-level file, exact ages
fit_codes.estimated: only an overlapping published band exists; the value shown is for approx_band, never pro-rated
fit_codes.unavailable: no published or computable figure for this band

race_notes: Romania records citizenship, never ethnicity, in these data. Labels as published.
ANITP's open dataset is the only official source crossing citizenship with age; police and prosecution statistics publish no citizenship.
Perpetrators are not published by citizenship.

anitp_vtp.name: Set date deschise VTP 2025 (open dataset of identified trafficking victims)
anitp_vtp.publisher: Agenția Națională împotriva Traficului de Persoane (ANITP), Ministry of Internal Affairs

series.title: Identified trafficking victims by citizenship: sexual exploitation, Romania, 2025
series.race_basis: Cetățenie (citizenship) as recorded by ANITP; not ethnicity
series.coverage: Romania, victims identified in 2025 (exploited in Romania or abroad)
series.no_rate_reason: No population denominators by citizenship and age are used.
series.native_note: The dataset gives single years of age, so every standard group is an exact count of records.
notes: Counted from ANITP's open dataset (one row per identified victim, with age at the time of trafficking and citizenship). Nothing is estimated.
Victims identified in 2025; Romanian citizens include every ethnic group (Roma, Hungarians and others); ANITP records no ethnicity.
Covers only sexual exploitation handled as trafficking.
